errors.text_span: като всеки етикет е маркиран със съответната стойност в лева/човекочас
errors.evidence: This phrasing is redundant and slightly awkward, as the unit for the y-axis labels has already been established by the axis title 'лева/човекочас'.
The description fails to mention that the blue line representing 'БВП на един отработен човекочас по текущи цени' is a dashed line, which is a key visual characteristic.

errors.text_span: след което има лек спад до 11.85 (2009)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states there is a drop ('спад') for the blue line. The values for the blue line actually increase from 10.29 in 2007 to 11.27 in 2008 and 11.85 in 2009.
The value 13.8 for the year 2010 belongs to the orange line, not the blue line. The correct value for the blue line in 2010 is 12.55.
The description fails to mention that the orange line representing 'БВП на един отработен човекочас по цени на 2015 г.' is a solid line.

errors.text_span: след което има лек спад до 14.55 (2012–2013)
errors.evidence: This is incorrect in two ways: 1) The orange line's value increases from 14.46 in 2011 to 14.87 in 2012 and 14.98 in 2013; there is no drop ('спад'). 2) The value 14.55 belongs to the blue line for the years 2012 and 2013.

The term 'стабилизира' (stabilizes) is an interpretation of the data's slowing growth rate. A more objective description would be to state that the value continues to increase, from 12.47 in 2006 to 12.88 in 2007 and 13.04 in 2008.
